steps.title: Project Setup & Directory Initialization
steps.description: Initialize the Android Gradle project with structural resources, matching targeted compile & target SDK 34 specifications.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure the app's build.gradle with compatible Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and proper Java 1.8 compatibility parameters.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Create the AndroidManifest.xml referencing the application launcher, correct package namespace, default orientation, and correct application theme details.

steps.title: Create Color Scheme and Value Resources
steps.description: Establish standard layout themes, color templates (slate colors, vibrant secondary accent indicators, soft whites), and dimensional paddings.

steps.title: Design Button Background Drawables
steps.description: Implement modern rounded-rectangle shapes with modern dynamic state-selector overlays for clicks and active selections.

steps.title: Construct Scrollable History Item Layout
steps.description: Develop a dedicated XML view template for calculating/rendering list records in the calculation history tracker.

steps.title: Design Main Calculator Layout UI
steps.description: Design a highly responsive, pixel-perfect calculator keyboard interface with high-contrast display regions, live dynamic preview, and toggleable calculation history panel.

steps.title: Implement High-Performance Parser Engine
steps.description: Build a robust, custom mathematical parser supporting standard order of operations (MDAS) with error handling to avoid relying on external dependencies.

steps.title: Code UI Binding & Click Listener Handlers
steps.description: Connect UI calculator keys to click triggers, wire haptic vibratory clicks for responsive modern hardware feedback, and manage input validation rules.

steps.title: Implement Calculation History Storage Log
steps.description: Add dynamic history panel interaction allowing users to view previous entries, retrieve history items, and load expressions directly back to calculation screen.

steps.title: Verification & Layout Optimization Check
steps.description: Run strict UI alignment checks on low-density screen targets, verify character overflows, and optimize output sizing dynamically.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Assemble and build the final executable debug APK with Gradle task pipeline.
